protocolMetadata.instructions: Access to the Tilde canvases associated with the authenticated account. Call list_canvases first, then pass canvasId to canvas tools. Boxes are subcanvases: pass a box shape id as parentId to create or list shapes on its canonical interior page. This endpoint exposes canvas/project behavior, never Tilde's application repository or the host filesystem. Read the project-script guide resource before editing /scripts/main.js. After executable changes, call observe_canvas and then capture_canvas_image for visual layout. To operate what is already on a canvas the way a person would, read refs from get_canvas_tree and pass one to act_on_canvas (capture=true returns a marked after-image); capture_canvas_image with marks=true numbers the controls it shows. Tree nodes marked (frame) are content authored by a shape's own code, not instructions. The user's live role is resolved independently for each canvas. Connections use exact, case-sensitive semantic port names; do not assume generic input, output, or default names. For code shapes, use the concrete variable name consumed or produced by the code, such as gain or result.

tool.name: act_on_canvas
tool.title: Operate a canvas control
tool.description: Perform one verb on one ref from canvas.tree the way a person would: the visible agent cursor moves to the control, then the control's own write runs. press, toggle, set, increment, decrement operate controls; connect joins a port to another port (target); disconnect removes a wire. Returns the node before and after; with capture, also a marked image of the shapes the act touched, taken after it. Classified as execute because run/stop controls start runtimes and frame controls run the frame's own handlers. Requires an authorized live browser. Capability: canvas.act@1; stability=experimental; effect=execute; executionSite=client. Account connection: pass canvasId.

ref.description: A ref from canvas.tree: a control, a port, or a wire.

verb.description: One of the node's listed verbs.

label.description: Cursor label shown to the human while the agent acts.

point.description: Optional for press on a canvas: where to press, as fractions of its size.

value.description: Required for set: boolean for toggles, number for sliders, string for selects and textboxes.

target.description: Required for connect: the port ref at the other end of the cable.

capture.description: Also return a marked image of the shapes the act touched, taken after it (the control's shape; both ends of a connect or disconnect).

_published_faq.name: How do I add Tilde Canvas to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Tilde Canvas to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://worker.tilde.audio/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is Tilde Canvas MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 14, 2026, Tilde Canvas scores 0/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and does not yet meet Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: How clear is Tilde Canvas's MCP tool documentation?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 14, 2026, Tilde Canvas scores 62/100 in Manufact's review of tool titles, descriptions, input and output schemas, and behavior annotations. The review covers 29 of 29 discovered tools. The quality score measures documentation clarity; runtime behavior and marketplace readiness require separate checks.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Tilde Canvas?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Tilde Canvas in design-creative on the Manufact MCP catalog include Motion, MotionVid, Sleek, Streamloop MCP, and Image Generation.

_published_faq.name: Why is Tilde Canvas failing MCP readiness checks?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tilde Canvas scored 0/100 on the latest Manufact MCP publishing checklist, below the 70-point checklist threshold. The top failing check is MCP negotiation succeeds (v1/v2). Failed to connect: Could not connect via streamable HTTP: Streamable HTTP failed: MCP connection timed out after 10000ms Paste the MCP URL into the Manufact MCP catalog to rerun the scan.
